subject: [RFC PATCH v3 11/14] mm/memcontrol, migrate: Transfer tier charge on migration

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch addresses a problem in the Linux kernel's memory control system where migrations across different tiers of memory allocation (per-memcg tier limits) can cause the destination tier to exceed its limit. To fix this, the patch introduces a new function `mem_cgroup_migrate_charge` that charges the destination tier separately during migration, attempting to reclaim memory if necessary and failing the migration if not enough headroom is created. The patch also updates existing functions to handle cross-tier migrations correctly.
